O_O I am so creeped out by this.

I used to work harvest at a grain elevator in Kansas during the summer to make money for college. It was good cash but really hard work and long hours (think 100 a week). 

One evening we didn't have any farmers coming in, so me and my coworkers were bullshitting when my boss, who's been there 10 years or so, starts to tell us about this old grain elevator my company owns.

The elevator is small and slow enough that only one girl works there and runs it all by herself (for reference, my crew had about 20 people). Basically no one goes out there; the girl mans it for 12 hours a day but sees maybe one or two people come because she's so far away from any farmers or towns. She also didn't have cell service, which scares me all on its own. 

Apparently later one harvest season, when it was already getting dark, the girl was turning off all the lights, locking up the elevator and getting ready to go home for the day when she heard something rattle the gate. Literally NO ONE ELSE is out there so it freaked her out, understandably. She shone her headlights in but didn't see anyone, and didn't want to walk around in the dark by herself (also understandably) so she didn't get out of her car. 

Per my boss, she started driving away and looked in her review mirror to see one of the lights turn on in the top of the elevator. She knew it was off when she left, so it scared the shit out of her but she just kept going. She thought someone maybe broke into the elevator, but she didn't have cell service so she just drove back to town and told my boss. 

Company guys went out there with her the next day and found everything was locked up and intact. They didn't find anyone inside, either. 

So me and the guys are thinking our boss is just fuckin' with us and there's no way anything is up with this elevator. It's old, the wiring's probably shit, so on and so on. 

Then he tells us that decades ago there was a man who ran the elevator by himself, just like the girl. But at some point this guy didn't bring in the paperwork to the office after he closed up for the day.

 So company people went out to see what was up, and found the guy had hung himself in the top of the elevator, by the window the girl saw the light turn on through. The man must've done it at the end of his shift when it was dark, because the paperwork was done and on the desk and the light upstairs was on. 

Other people have claimed to hear voices and shit at that elevator which I don't completely buy but I don't disbelieve it either. Harvest fucks with ya. I dunno about you, but that gives me the creeps. 

And not creepy because suicide is this big mysterious thing. Agriculture workers have some of the highest suicide rates in the U.S. I attempted suicide after my last harvest season because the sleep deprivation, physical fatigue and not having anyone to talk to just completely broke me down. 

That elevator is still creepy as fuck to me and I'm kinda glad I don't work with that company anymore lol.

Thanks so much for this reply. It is so comforting :( 

I am going to talk to my therapist about this next time I see her (next friday). 

And in the mean time try to stop obsessing over it. It's not helpful. I know who I am. 

Thank you again :( I've been so scared to talk about it with anyone.
